episode: The Ships That Were Trapped in the Suez Canal for Eight Years
assumptions: beat duration = narration words / 2.5 words per second
authentic share is an upper bound: a beat counts as real when it shows at least one authentic asset, even if graphics also appear
standards_provisional: all references from a single channel

findings.name: AI-generated imagery
findings.standard: 0% (hard rule; none of the 28 non-AI-Tested reference videos shows any)
findings.why: Generated pictures read as artificial when used as decoration.

findings.name: Authentic media share
findings.measured: 61% of estimated time shows at least one authentic asset (upper bound)
findings.standard: reference band 56-73% real captured (sampled; -12 points tolerance)
findings.why: The references that look least artificial are built on real captured material; constructed graphics should explain what real media cannot.

findings.name: All-constructed stretch
findings.standard: longest in the references 135 s (sampled runs of 15 s); FAIL above 1.5x
findings.why: Long runs of graphics without any real picture are the 'AI slideshow' pattern the references avoid.

findings.name: Caption / text overlay share
findings.measured: 61% of time on beats that carry a caption, label, kicker, badge or stamp
findings.why: Text on every scene is not what the references do; labels belong to key terms, footage and credits.

findings.name: Repeated media
findings.standard: no asset on more than 2 beats (author's rule; no reference measurement)
findings.why: Repeating one picture reads as generic filler.

findings.name: Credit on every third-party picture
findings.measured: 6 without a credit field in the scene: H04:bitter-lake-space.jpg, H09:bitter-lake-space.jpg, H12:bitter-lake-space.jpg, H14b:boat-port-tewfik-1967.jpg, H15:canal-1967-b.jpg, H19:suezship-1973.jpg
findings.standard: 100% (hard rule; the references show credit or source lines on borrowed material)
findings.why: CLAUDE.md: no media without a recorded source; references credit borrowed clips on screen.

findings.name: Licence and source recorded
findings.standard: every asset has licence, source URL and commercial use allowed (hard rule)

findings.name: Long unchanging visual
findings.measured: longest single beat 26 s (beat length, not measured change)
findings.standard: longest static stretch in the references 57 s (frame-difference score); flag above max(60 s, that)
findings.why: A beat that long needs internal change (camera move, reveal, new panel) or a cut to real media.

findings.name: Scene-change rate
findings.measured: 4.0 beats/min (a beat can contain several internal changes)
findings.why: Compare only as an indication: beats are not shots.

findings.name: Visual matches narration (lexical screen only)
findings.measured: 3 real pictures share no content word with their narration: H09:bitter-lake-space.jpg, H13:suezship-1973.jpg, H19:suezship-1973.jpg
findings.standard: a person confirms each flagged picture shows what is said (a word match is not proof of relevance)
findings.why: A picture unrelated to the narration is the strongest 'filler' signal.

findings.name: Audio checks
findings.measured: no cue sheet for this channel
